notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK checks for adapter-managed connection loss combined with the standard Automatic Resign Directive. The portable source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback model, fault fixture, and object and attribute names. It verifies standard directive round trips, Connection Lost, retained-object assumption delivery after unconditional divestiture, two-object deletion plus divestiture, suppression of stale owner-release work after cancellation of a pending acquisition, explicit divestiture to a surviving candidate, bounded cleanup, and no private headers, registries, provider names, or diagnostics. It is source and API traceability only.
